note: Internal list for the owner only. Nothing here appears in the public Books list. Duplicates are never listed; the owner picks one version and the winner is listed then.

items.question: Which Kahf version to keep?
items.detail: Three successive versions of إضاءات من سورة الكهف — الجزء الأول: 126 pp (sent Nov 16), 135 pp (Nov 18), 138 pp (Nov 19). Likely the latest (138 pp) is the fullest, but only the owner / the Sheikh can confirm.
items.recommendation: Keep the 138 pp Nov 19 version unless the Sheikh says otherwise

items.question: Which infidelity version to keep?
items.detail: Two versions of الخيانة الزوجية وسبل التعامل معها: 16 pp (sent Nov 7) and 17 pp (sent Nov 17).
items.recommendation: Keep the 17 pp Nov 17 version unless the Sheikh says otherwise

items.question: List the PhD manuscript as a second format?
items.detail: The 819-page DOCX is the source manuscript of the same PhD book already listed in 4 parts (1,057 pp). It is the same work, not a separate book.
items.recommendation: Attach as a downloadable source-manuscript format on the PhD entry; do not list separately

items.question: What to do with the Noor Sprouts newsletters?
items.detail: Two English issues + one Arabic issue of the Noor Sprouts parenting newsletter. These are the owner's own project, not the Sheikh's books.
items.recommendation: Exclude from the Sheikh's Books list; owner decides whether they belong anywhere in the library and under what credit

items.question: Who wrote Proud To Be Muslims #16?
items.detail: The file (10 pp, English, series #16) states no author anywhere. It is listed with the author omitted rather than guessed.
items.recommendation: Confirm with the Sheikh whether it is his; credit him only if confirmed
